experiments.name: Best Fall River Paddle Window
experiments.hypothesis: People planning Michigan fall color trips will use a combined fall-color plus river-paddling decision handoff often enough to justify a distinct tool.

promotionGate.searchEvidence: A fresh 28-day Search Console export shows distinct query demand combining fall/color intent with river, paddle, canoe, kayak, float, Au Sable, or Manistee intent.
promotionGate.networkEvidence: Contextual test has at least 100 symbolic exposures and at least a 5% handoff rate, or equivalent strong evidence across two test surfaces.
promotionGate.safety: Do not create a standalone canonical if the observed demand is adequately served by the existing Fall Color, Au Sable, Manistee, or Outdoor Weekend owners.
promotionGate.decision: Build a standalone canonical only when searchEvidence is true and networkEvidence is true and safety remains true.
